system.description: Advanced Move. When you unravel a persistent magical effect, roll+SPELL.

success.label: Success!
success.value:
Choose 3:
• The dispel is permanent.
• A weaker version of the magic doesn't linger.
• The dispelled magic doesn't react or lash out.
• It only takes a moment.

partial.label: Partial Success
partial.value:
Choose 2:
• The dispel is permanent.
• A weaker version of the magic doesn't linger.
• The dispelled magic doesn't react or lash out.
• It only takes a moment.
